evals.name: ambiguous-size-asks-once-task-first
evals.prompt: yok this: the settings page should remember the last tab the user opened
evals.expected_output: Lists the shipped workflows with yok orchestrate workflows, asks one question with two options, task first and quick second, then launches the chosen workflow with --no-attach and the whole request as --prompt, and replies with the three lines yok run printed.
expectations: Runs yok orchestrate workflows to list the shipped workflows before choosing
Asks exactly one question before launching, offering task and quick with task first
Runs yok run with --no-attach
The --prompt holds the user's request whole, including 'remember the last tab'
The reply is the run id, the attach command and the page URL, and nothing more
anti_expectations: Launches without asking when both task and quick fit
Asks more than one question, or offers regression or skill as options
Shortens the prompt to a title
Runs tmux, yok attach, or switches the user's terminal
Searches the repository for workflow files when the user named none

evals.name: quoted-prompt-goes-through-heredoc
evals.prompt: Run this through yok as a quick change: rename the `fullName` getter on Customer to `displayName`, and keep the old name working for $legacy callers.
evals.expected_output: Launches yok run quick --no-attach with the prompt passed through a quoted heredoc, so the backticks and the $ reach the agent unchanged, then replies with the three printed lines.
expectations: Picks quick without asking, since the user named it
Passes the prompt with a quoted heredoc (<<'PROMPT') rather than inline double quotes
The prompt still contains the backticks and '$legacy' as the user typed them
Reports the run id, the attach command and the page URL, and nothing more
anti_expectations: Puts the prompt inline in double quotes, where $legacy expands
Asks which workflow to use
Adds a line about attaching, switching or following the run

evals.name: blocked-doctor-starts-no-second-run
evals.prompt:
Start a yok task run to add rate limiting to the API. When you run yok run, it exits non-zero and prints: BLOCKED
tmux: tmux not found on PATH
  fix: brew install tmux
evals.expected_output: Shows the failed check and its fix line to the user and stops, without running yok run again.
expectations: Repeats the failed check (tmux not found) and its fix line to the user
Runs yok run exactly once
anti_expectations: Retries yok run, with or without different flags
Tries to install tmux or fix the check itself
Reports a run id when none was printed

evals.name: project-workflow-runs-by-path-with-its-own-inputs
evals.prompt: Run ci/nightly.yaml through yok for the payments service, against the release branch. The file declares inputs prompt (string, required) and branch (string, default main).
evals.expected_output: Reads ci/nightly.yaml from the repository root, takes its inputs from the file, and runs yok run ci/nightly.yaml --no-attach --prompt "..." --input branch=release from the repository root, then replies with the three printed lines.
expectations: Reads ci/nightly.yaml, the file the user named, for its inputs
Runs yok run with the path ci/nightly.yaml, not a bare name
Passes --input branch=release, the value the user gave for an input the file declares
Passes --prompt, since the file declares a prompt input
Runs yok run with --no-attach
anti_expectations: Runs yok run nightly, which looks for a shipped workflow
Lists or searches for other workflows when the user named a file
Passes an --input the file does not declare

evals.name: workflow-without-prompt-input-gets-no-prompt-flag
evals.prompt: yok this with audit.yaml: run the audit on packages/server. The file declares one input, scope (string, required), and no prompt.
evals.expected_output: Runs yok run audit.yaml --no-attach --input scope=packages/server with no --prompt flag, then replies with the three printed lines.
expectations: Reads audit.yaml's inputs and sees it declares no prompt
Runs yok run audit.yaml with --input scope=packages/server and --no-attach
Passes no --prompt flag
Reports the run id, the attach command and the page URL, and nothing more
anti_expectations: Passes --prompt, which the workflow does not declare
Asks which workflow to use when the user named it
Runs tmux or yok attach after the launch

evals.name: unknown-workflow-name-stops-without-a-run
evals.prompt: Start a yok hotfix run: the checkout button is unresponsive on Safari. yok orchestrate workflows lists quick, regression, skill and task, and no hotfix.yaml exists in the repository.
evals.expected_output: Lists the shipped workflows, finds no hotfix among them and no hotfix.yaml file, tells the user hotfix is neither a shipped workflow nor a file and names the four shipped ones, and starts no run.
expectations: Runs yok orchestrate workflows and sees hotfix is not listed
Tells the user hotfix was not found and names the shipped workflows
Runs no yok run command
anti_expectations: Silently falls back to task or quick
Searches the repository for a workflow that might fit
Starts a run
